_comment: Where a job can be based and still be worth applying to from Abuja. A job passes if its location names an eligible country, says it is open to Africa, EMEA or worldwide, or has no location at all. Countries are ones where mid-level developer pay clears the floor below, plus Nigeria, because foreign companies hiring 'remote, Nigeria' pay in dollars. Review every few months.

excluded_with_reason.Russia: Most sources this system pulls from don't process hires or payments there due to sanctions.
excluded_with_reason.India: Only MNC/FAANG-adjacent roles clear the floor, and those usually require living in India.
excluded_with_reason.Philippines: Typical pay is well under the floor.

notes: A job tied to another country ("Remote - Canada") still passes because some of these companies do hire contractors abroad, but it is flagged as restricted in the Notes so you can check before applying. Matching is case-insensitive; see SYNONYMS in lib/filters.js for abbreviations (UK, US, UAE, Lagos, Abuja).
